about_the_game:
Transform into a majestic dragon and explore a vast, mysterious world floating high above the clouds. Discover ancient ruins, uncover forgotten history, and restore balance to a land touched by an ancient curse.

The empire told you that nothing lay beyond its borders, just endless sky and forgotten myths. But when you spread your wings and take flight, you uncover a world far greater than you ever imagined.

As Nur, a child of dragons, you find yourself in the land of Tasneem: a breathtaking world of floating islands, lush valleys, and towering ruins. But something is wrong. A dark corruption spreads through the land, twisting its beauty into decay.

Will you be the one to set Tasneem free? Or will its secrets remain buried in the clouds?

Award-Winning Adventure

SOAR: Pillars of Tasneem was honored as a "Best in Play" winner at GDC 2022, recognizing its breathtaking world, innovative flight mechanics, and immersive atmosphere. Take to the skies and experience an award-winning journey for yourself!

  • Experience the Pure Joy of Flight: Soar freely across the open skies: ride the wind, carve through canyons, and dance between floating ruins. Whether you seek relaxing exploration or high-speed aerial thrills, the sky is yours to command.

  • A Vast & Vibrant Open World: Tasneem is alive with wonders waiting to be discovered. Explore sunlit archipelagos, lush forests, ancient temples, and towering pillars, each with their own mysteries and history.

  • Uncover the Lost History of Tasneem: The ruins whisper of a forgotten past, one that ties your empire to the very heart of Tasneem’s suffering. Decipher ancient glyphs, uncover hidden temples, and piece together the truth of a world on the brink.

  • Aesthetic, Meditative Vibes: SOAR is more than just an adventure, it’s a wholesome, relaxing experience. Fly at your own pace, immerse yourself in the beauty of the world, and let your mind wander as you glide through the skies.

  • Play Your Own Way: Whether you're looking for a peaceful escape or a high-speed thrill ride, SOAR adapts to your mood. Weave between islands in a flow state, race against time in speed trials, or simply glide across the horizon as the music carries you.

  • An Immersive Soundscape: Let the world pull you in with a stunning, dynamic soundtrack that ebbs and flows with your journey. Every moment in SOAR is accompanied by an enchanting atmosphere of music and sound.

Had a stressful day? Let the wind guide you.

Looking for a challenge? Push your flight to the limit.

Need something to pair with a podcast? Enjoy effortless, beautiful exploration.

In SOAR: Pillars of Tasneem, the sky is not just a setting: it’s a feeling, a journey, and a world waiting to be discovered.

Add SOAR: Pillars of Tasneem to your wishlist and prepare to take flight!

name: Soar: Pillars of Tasneem

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Using a graphics card without full DX12 support will cause the game to crash on launch. The GTX 900 and 1000 series have partial, but incomplete, DX12 support, so the game will crash on those cards. While you can force the game to run with DirectX 11 using '-dx11' in the launch options, it'll run very poorly, as the Corruption effect relies on DX12.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
